thread:
sarah_ops: FYI incoming case from BrightLeaf — invoice INV-2026-089 failed. Customer says AP requires a PO to pay; our system attempted a card charge which declined. Need Net 60 approval and temporary access while they get the PO. Details below.

billing-bot: Payment attempt failed • card_declined (code: 402)

jamal_support: Can you paste the invoice payload and any error logs? Also, do we have a PO number on file?

sarah_ops: No PO on file. Invoice payload (redacted): ```{
  "invoice_id": "INV-2026-089",
  "customer": "BrightLeaf Ltd",
  "amount": 34500,
  "currency": "USD",
  "po_number": "",
  "vat_id": ""
}```

kevin_finance: Quick policy note — Net terms >30 require finance sign-off for new customers. We can escalate to Net 60 provisional if legal + PO arrives within 14 days. For now we can issue a provisional credit hold. I'll need the signed PO scan and customer legal entity.

ana_cust_success: I can ask them to upload the PO to the portal. Also flagged VAT — customer in IE, missing VAT ID may block invoice due to tax reporting. They need to submit VAT registration to clear tax.

jamal_support: Repro steps we used: `curl -X POST https://billing.redwood.ai/v1/invoices/emit -d 'invoice_id=INV-2026-089'` -> response: `400 Payment failed: card_declined`. We also see `billing.events` entry: `{"type":"payment.failed","reason":"card_declined","attempts":1}`

kevin_finance: Proposed actions: (1) grant 7-day provisional access + credit of $34.5k pending PO, (2) require signed PO + VAT ID to finalize Net 60, (3) block further auto-charges until we have PO in invoice metadata. Approving provisional credit requires EM+Finance sign-off.

ana_cust_success: Approved 7-day provisional access. I'll request PO and VAT ID now and attach to SR-6789. Customer asked if they can pay via wire — send bank details, but we still need PO for their internal workflow.

sarah_ops: I've updated the invoice metadata once we receive the PO and disabled auto-retries. Ticket SR-6789 created and linked: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/SR-6789

jamal_support: I'll mark this high priority and add a rollback policy if charges go through unexpectedly. Please drop the PO scan here once available :+1:

kevin_finance: Once PO arrives, I'll approve Net 60 for BrightLeaf and remove provisional credit. Note: mark account as 'net-terms-pending' in internal admin so billing doesn't autopay.

sarah_ops: Closing loop — created admin note and provisional credit. Leaving thread open until PO + VAT ID received.
